sources.title: Krea 2 Turbo Official Comfy-Org Checkpoints (Krea2)
sources.snippet: Krea 2 is a text-to-image diffusion model that generates images from natural-language text descriptions. The model is designed to support creative, commercial, developer, and research use cases, including image generation, concepting, design exploration, visual production workflows, and integration into applications and creative tools.

sources.title: Krea 2 Turbo - AI Model | Layer
sources.snippet: Krea 2 Turbo Krea 2 Turbo is the speed-optimized, open-source version of Krea 2, built to generate high-fidelity images from text in seconds while preserving the model's signature aesthetic range. Distilled for rapid inference, it is ideal for live iteration and high-volume creative production where turnaround matters.
